hooks.name: CDK Synth on Change
hooks.description: Runs cdk synth (and cdk diff when applicable) whenever CDK Python code in infrastructure/ is saved, validating it against the eks-ingress-replica-config design (VPC/EKS/SSM/Lambda-Provider/pinned remote Helm chart) and least-privilege IAM.

action.prompt:
CDK code in `infrastructure/` has been modified. Please:
1. Run `cdk synth` inside `infrastructure/` (using the project's venv/`pip install -r requirements.txt` if not already installed) to validate the CDK code.
2. Check for any synthesis errors or warnings and fix them before proceeding.
3. Validate that the generated CloudFormation templates reflect the settled design (`.kiro/specs/eks-ingress-replica-config/design.md`): VPC with `nat_gateways=1`, EKS cluster on `aws_cdk.aws_eks` (not `aws_eks_v2`) pinned to `KubernetesVersion.V1_32` with `KubectlV32Layer`, `EndpointAccess.PUBLIC_AND_PRIVATE`, a single `t3.medium` managed node group (min=1/max=1/desired=1), the `/platform/account/env` `StringParameter`, the Provider-wrapped Lambda CustomResource exposing `ReplicaCount`, and the `ingress-nginx` Helm chart installed via a live remote fetch using `chart`+`repository`+`version` (never a `chart_asset`).
4. Run `cdk diff` in `infrastructure/` if a previous deployment exists, to show what would change, and flag any unexpected resource replacements (especially replacements to the EKS cluster or VPC, which are disruptive).
5. Check the synthesized template for security issues: confirm the Lambda's IAM policy grants `ssm:GetParameter` on exactly one resource ARN (`/platform/account/env`, via `grant_read()`), never a wildcard `parameter/*`.
6. Confirm the Helm chart is still a pinned live remote fetch: `chart="ingress-nginx"`, `repository="https://kubernetes.github.io/ingress-nginx"`, and an explicit `version` (currently `4.15.1`). Flag any `chart_asset` reappearing, any chart contents committed back into the repo, and especially a missing or floating `version`, since an unpinned version lets the installed chart drift silently.
7. Verify the stack still enforces the `lambda/` / `infrastructure/` folder isolation: `infrastructure/` code should only reference `lambda/` via the relative path string passed to `lambda_.Code.from_asset("../lambda")`, with no other shared files.
8. Confirm the CDK context `env` still defaults to `development` when unset, and that changing it via `-c env=staging`/`-c env=production` doesn't alter anything else in the synthesized template besides the SSM parameter value and downstream `ReplicaCount`.
Report any deviation from `.kiro/specs/eks-ingress-replica-config/design.md` clearly, and do not apply infrastructure changes beyond what's needed to fix synthesis errors without confirming with the user first.
